title: AI-Crypto Convergence, Regulatory Scrutiny, Institutional Infrastructure
snippet: February's defining story was ElevenLabs' $500M raise at $11B valuation. Morgan Stanley filed for crypto custody bank charter. 11 US Senators urged Binance AML probe. CME Group announced 24/7 crypto derivatives trading. Paradigm launched $1.5B AI-crypto fund.

title: Market Volatility, Institutional Momentum, Security Challenges
snippet: January delivered volatile markets with $100B erased in a weekend crash. $2.5B in liquidations hit as Bitcoin fell to $77K. UAE-backed investor took 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto firm for $500M. Security breaches totaled $86M across 16 incidents.
